sections.skill: Calculate and compare the true cost of high-cost credit and identify safer alternatives

questions.prompt: A payday lender charges a $45 fee to borrow $300 for 14 days. What is the APR (nearest whole percent)?
questions.intro: Payday loans are small, short-term loans, often due on your next payday, with a flat fee. Converting the fee to an APR shows the true yearly cost: APR = (fee ÷ amount borrowed) × (365 ÷ days) × 100.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.A: Gives the fee as a percent of the loan for two weeks
misconceptions.C: Uses the fee as a percent
misconceptions.B: Counts the number of two-week periods

sources: CFPB: A typical two-week payday loan with a $15 per $100 fee equals an APR of almost 400%. (https://www.consumerfinance.gov/ask-cfpb/what-is-a-payday-loan-en-1567/)

questions.prompt: Instead of repaying, Kim "rolls over" a $300 payday loan four times, paying a $45 fee each time. How much has she paid in fees, and how much does she still owe?

choices.text: $180 in fees; still owes $300
$45 in fees; owes nothing
$180 in fees; owes nothing
$300 in fees; owes $45

questions.intro: A rollover (or renewal) pays only the fee and extends the loan, so the original amount is still owed. Repeated rollovers can cost more than the original loan.
questions.feedback: 4 × $45 = $180 in fees, and the $300 principal is still due.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.B: Thinks one fee repays the loan

questions.prompt: A rent-to-own store offers a TV for $25 a week for 78 weeks. The same TV sells for $600. How much more does rent-to-own cost?
questions.intro: Rent-to-own lets you use an item while making weekly or monthly payments; you own it only after all payments. The total paid is often far more than the store price.

questions.prompt: A car title loan lends Ray $1,000 using his car as collateral, with a 25% monthly fee. What is the biggest risk?

choices.text: The lender pays his insurance while he owes money
His credit score will automatically rise
The lender will pay off his car loan
He could lose the car if he cannot repay

questions.correct_answer: He could lose the car if he cannot repay
questions.intro: A car title loan is a short-term loan that uses your vehicle as collateral. Fees are high, and if you cannot repay, the lender can repossess the car you may need to get to work.
questions.feedback: The car is collateral; losing it can also cost him his job transportation.

questions.prompt: Buy now, pay later (BNPL) splits a $200 purchase into 4 payments of $50 every two weeks with no interest. Jo misses two payments and is charged a $7 late fee each time. What does the purchase cost her?
questions.intro: Buy now, pay later plans let you split a purchase into a few installments, often with no interest if paid on time. Late fees can apply, several plans at once can be hard to track, and spending can creep up.

sections.skill: Fees as a cost of borrowing
sections.relationship: High-cost credit hides its price in fees; students must see a fee as part of the cost of borrowing.

questions.prompt: A lender charges a $20 fee to borrow $100 for one month. What is the cost of borrowing?

choices.text: $0, because it is a fee not interest

questions.intro: Fees are part of the cost of borrowing, just like interest. Total repaid = amount borrowed + interest + fees.
questions.feedback: The $20 fee is the cost of borrowing.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.D: Thinks fees are not a cost

questions.prompt: Which is a lower-cost alternative to a payday loan for a $200 emergency?

choices.text: A second payday loan to pay the first
A car title loan
A rent-to-own purchase
A small loan from a credit union

questions.correct_answer: A small loan from a credit union
questions.intro: Credit unions, some banks, and employers offer small-dollar loans or paycheck advances at much lower cost than payday lenders. Asking a creditor for more time or using savings also avoids high fees.
questions.feedback: Small credit union loans usually cost far less than payday loans.

The government pays the fees
They require little checking but charge very high fees
They lower your other bills

questions.correct_answer: They require little checking but charge very high fees
questions.feedback: Easy approval comes with very high fees that can trap borrowers in repeat loans.

questions.prompt: Which question helps someone avoid needing a payday loan next time?

choices.text: How can I build a small emergency fund?
Which payday lender has the nicest store?
How can I find a lender that checks nothing?
How many payday loans can I have at once?

questions.correct_answer: How can I build a small emergency fund?
questions.intro: Most payday loans cover regular expenses or small emergencies. Building even a small savings cushion breaks the cycle.
questions.feedback: Even a small fund replaces the need for high-cost credit.

questions.prompt: Jo has four BNPL plans with payments due on different dates. What is the main risk?

choices.text: BNPL plans always charge 30% interest on every purchase
BNPL plans raise her credit score with each purchase
Losing track and missing payments, adding fees
BNPL purchases cannot be returned

questions.correct_answer: Losing track and missing payments, adding fees
questions.intro: "Loan stacking" means having several buy now, pay later plans at once. Payments on different schedules are easy to forget.
questions.feedback: Several plans at once make it easy to overspend and miss payments.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.D: Confuses payment plans with store return rules

questions.prompt: Which feature makes rent-to-own different from a regular purchase on an installment loan?

choices.text: You own the item immediately
There is no cost beyond the store's regular price
The item is always new
You do not own the item until the final payment

questions.correct_answer: You do not own the item until the final payment
questions.intro: With an installment loan, you own the item when you buy it and repay the lender. With rent-to-own, the store keeps ownership while you make rental payments.
questions.feedback: Miss a payment and the store can take the item back, even after many payments.

sections.skill: Why people use high-cost credit, and how to respond

questions.prompt: Why do many people turn to payday loans?

choices.text: They need cash quickly and lack savings or other credit
Payday loans are usually cheaper than small credit union loans
Payday loans improve credit scores with each loan
Payday loans have low fees when paid on time

questions.correct_answer: They need cash quickly and lack savings or other credit
questions.intro: Lack of savings, poor access to bank credit, and urgent bills push people toward high-cost credit. Understanding the reasons helps identify better alternatives.
questions.feedback: Urgency and lack of alternatives drive payday borrowing.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.B: Assumes fast cash is low cost
misconceptions.C: Assumes payday lenders report to credit bureaus
misconceptions.D: Misses that the fee itself is a very high APR

questions.prompt: Ella cannot pay a $150 electric bill on time. Which step should she try BEFORE high-cost credit?

choices.text: Take a title loan on her car
Ignore the bill until it goes to collections
Take three BNPL plans for groceries
Call the utility to ask for a payment plan

questions.correct_answer: Call the utility to ask for a payment plan
questions.intro: Many creditors, including utilities, offer payment plans or hardship programs. Asking costs nothing and can avoid fees.
questions.feedback: Creditors often have payment plans that cost far less than high-cost loans.

questions.prompt: Which statement about state rules on payday loans is MOST accurate?

choices.text: Every state allows unlimited payday fees
Payday loans are illegal everywhere
Rules differ by state, and some ban them
Only the federal government sets payday rules

questions.correct_answer: Rules differ by state, and some ban them
questions.intro: States set many of the rules for payday and other small-dollar loans, including rate caps and outright bans.
questions.feedback: Some states cap rates or prohibit payday loans; rules vary, so check your state's regulator.

questions.prompt: Online "instant cash" sites ask for your bank login to approve a loan. What is the safest response?

choices.text: Never share bank logins with a lender
Share it, since approval apps are encrypted
Share it, then change the password after the loan arrives
Share your PIN instead of the password

questions.correct_answer: Never share bank logins with a lender
questions.intro: Unlicensed online lenders and scammers may ask for bank logins to drain accounts. Check that a lender is licensed in your state.
questions.feedback: Bank logins give full account access; never share them with a lender.
questions.topic: High-cost credit: payday loans, title loans, rent-to-own, and buy now, pay later

misconceptions.B: Trusts encryption claims; a login gives full account access
misconceptions.C: Damage can happen before the password is changed
misconceptions.D: A PIN is just as sensitive as a password
